skills.name: Japanese Teleporter
skills.description: Takes off mask revealing her face. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Use Rate +33%  (10 sec) *Skill Hit Rate +33% (10 sec) *Allies' Skill Range +20% (10 sec)

skills.name: Magic Of The Ring
skills.description: Summons a shield with the power of the ring. Good effects on allies.  *Creates a shield over an area (5 sec) *HP x 40% Area Recovery (per sec) (10 sec) *Resists enemies' summoning skills (10 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Mushoku Tensei II
abilities.description: Mushoku Tensei II Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)
